title: How can we help?
lead: Send us a message and we will reply by email. For company training, tell us roughly how many people you would like to train.
name: Full name

aside.title: Booking a course
aside.body: Choose a session on the course page — you can enrol and pay online.

aside.title: Checking a certificate
aside.body: Use the verification page with the certificate number or QR code.

aside.title: Company training
aside.body: Create a company account to buy seats, or send an inquiry for larger groups.

detailsNote: Contact details shown on this demonstration site are placeholders. The business phone number, email and address will be published here before launch.

verify.title: Check that a certificate is genuine
verify.lead: Enter the certificate number printed on the certificate, or scan its QR code.
verify.label: Certificate number
verify.hint: Format: AMN, the year, then eight characters.
verify.notFoundBody: Check the number and try again. If it still cannot be found, the certificate was not issued by Aman Academy.
verify.privacy: For privacy, this page shows only the holder's name, the course, the dates and the certificate's status.
verify.meaning: A certificate confirms attendance of the live online course and a passed knowledge assessment. It is not a practical skills qualification.
verify.sample: This is a sample certificate from the demonstration site.
